name: CSL Finance Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1992, CSL Finance Ltd provides finance facilities to SME business and Wholesale 
business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CSL is a NBFC giving Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises and corporations secured loan. 
As of 9MFY25, it has presence in 7 states & 43 Branches, with an AUM of Rs.1,150 crore[2]

pros: Stock is trading at 1.13 times its book value
Company has delivered good profit growth of 26.3% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -3.77%
